visualCharacteristics.purpose: job posting strip showing location and employment type next to a map-pin icon

contentPattern.structure: one row; cells = location, employment type (and any extra facts); a single cell with values separated by | also works

usage: Under the title of career opportunity (job posting) pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for any short pipe-separated fact strip on job postings. The first value is treated as the location.
